description: Write the statements' transactions to an import file next to the PDFs (or in outDir). Formats: xlsx = Excel (.xlsx) (Transactions + summary sheet); csv = CSV (Any spreadsheet or accounting tool); qbo = QuickBooks (.qbo) (QuickBooks Desktop & Online bank upload); qb-csv = QuickBooks Online CSV (3-column Date, Description, Amount); xero = Xero CSV (Xero bank statement import); ofx = OFX (Quicken, Xero, Wave, most finance apps). csv and xlsx put all statements in one file; the import formats (qbo, qb-csv, xero, ofx) write one file per account, because each import goes into one bank account. separate = one file per statement. Statements with no transactions are skipped. Uses free monthly pages like get_transactions.

dateOrder.description: Override the detected date order, e.g. DMY for 03/04 = 3 April.

files.description: Absolute paths of statement PDFs on this computer. Several statements from one account can go together.

flipSigns.description: Multiply amounts by -1 (some tools want card charges positive).

intuBid.description: Intuit bank ID for .qbo files, if QuickBooks rejects the default.

outDir.description: Absolute folder for the export. Default: the folder of the first PDF.

password.description: Password for protected PDFs (the same one for every file).

separate.description: Write one export per statement instead of one combined file.

name: export_statements
title: Export statements to a file
